newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken jumps on S-E-Banken talk.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken jumps on S-E-Banken talk.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank Nordbanken jumped over five percent on Monday on renewed rumours about S-E-Banken buying the state's holding in the bank, brokers said.
At 1130 GMT Nordbanken shares were 10.5 crowns higher at 204 crowns on the Stockholm bourse.
"There are rumours and this speculation is behind this interest," one broker said. "There was talk for most of Friday about whether S-E-Banken would make a bid for Nordbanken over the weekend."

Rumours about S-E-Banken buying the state's 58 percent stake of Nordbanken worth an estimated 18.5 billion crowns were dismissed by Finance Minister Erik Asbrink eight days ago with a firm denial but the rumours have resurfaced, brokers said.
On Monday the rest of the banks were also firmer, driving the banking sector index up 2.71 percent while the rest of the market was 0.2 percent higher.
Handelsbanken was five higher at 177.5 crowns and S-E-Banken rose one to 60.50 crowns.
